description: This file defines a RecipeProvider class that manages recipe data, including loading, searching, updating favorites, and CRUD operations, interfacing with a RecipeService. It acts as a state management provider in a Flutter application.

classes.name: RecipeProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class providing recipe data management, including initialization, searching, favorite toggling, and CRUD operations.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Asynchronously loads all recipes, favorites, and custom recipes from the RecipeService and updates the provider's state.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a given Recipe, updating local state and notifying listeners.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive search across recipes by name, ingredients, or tags based on the input query.

methods.name: upsertRecipe
methods.description: Inserts or updates a recipe in the collection and persists it via the RecipeService.

methods.name: deleteRecipe
methods.description: Deletes a recipe from collections and persistent storage, updating favorite IDs accordingly.
